description: BUG-071..075 + R1 token-burn watch. Net-new dashboard (added 2026-06-30) for the post-Anthropic-refill window. Every panel uses a metric that exists at prod HEAD 73d9a58. Mirrors docker/grafana/dashboards/pipeline.json / wave2_observation.json conventions (datasource uid 'prometheus', schemaVersion 39). Threshold colours encode the alert thresholds from docker/prometheus/alerts.yml.

panels.title: max_tokens truncations (rate by stage) — BUG-071 P1/P1b
panels.description: tg_parser_llm_truncation_total{provider,model,stage}. The primary BUG-071 re-burn canary: a charged-but-truncated (stop_reason=max_tokens) reply. Healthy ~0 on all stages. Warn (alert TopicizationTruncationSpike) > 0.05/s; Critical (TopicizationTruncationBurst) > 0.2/s = at/above the pre-fix incident rate. discover stage can re-burn independently of the zero-card re-escalation.

panels.title: Failed batches (rate by stage) — BUG-071/074 P3b
panels.description: tg_parser_topicization_failed_batches_total{stage,channel_id} — direct mirror of TopicizationPipelineImpl.failed_batches. Counts truncation-drops AND non-truncation batch failures. Only topicization_generate is emitted today. Warn (alert TopicizationFailedBatchesHigh) > 0.05/s. Drill into channel_id with the panel below.

panels.title: Failed batches (1h increase by channel)
panels.description: Per-channel failed-batch volume over the last hour — answers 'which channel is burning failed batches?'.

panels.title: JSON-parse retries (rate by topicization stage) — BUG-074
panels.description: tg_parser_llm_json_parse_retry_total{stage}. After BUG-074, repair_json parses malformed-but-repairable replies on the FIRST attempt → these stages should be ~0. A sustained rate (alert TopicizationJsonRepairRetrySpike > 0.05/s) means repair is missing the class and the batch prompt is being re-issued (charged re-burn). Covers generate+merge+discover (broader than failed_batches).

panels.title: R1 marker-write failures (rate, healthy = 0)
panels.description: tg_parser_topicization_discover_attempted_mark_failed_total{channel_id} (BUG-075 R1). The only QUIET path to bounded re-feed: if the marker write fails while the discover call succeeds, the doc is re-fed to Phase-2 next tick. Healthy = EXACTLY 0 (background turns RED on any rate). Alert TopicizationDiscoverMarkerWriteFailing fires on any sustained > 0.

panels.title: R1 marker-write failures (24h total, healthy = 0)
panels.description: Cumulative marker-write failures over 24h. Any non-zero value means a channel's discover_attempted markers are not persisting → bounded re-burn. Background is RED on any count > 0.

panels.title: Reconcile discover docs fed (rate by channel) — convergence
panels.description: tg_parser_topicization_reconcile_discover_docs_total{channel_id} (BUG-075, post-refill). Docs fed to Phase-2 discover by the STANDING reconciliation hook specifically (reconcile_only path, NOT the normal new-docs incremental path). The convergence invariant is at-most-one discover per uncovered doc, so a TRANSIENT bursty rate during backlog-drain is legitimate and decays to 0. A SUSTAINED non-zero rate (alert TopicizationReconcileDiscoverSustained: rate[1h] > 0 for 2h) means reconcile is NOT converging (markers not persisting → re-feed, or the uncovered set keeps growing). Pair with the R1 marker-write panel above.

panels.title: Reconcile discover docs fed (1h increase by channel)
panels.description: Per-channel volume of docs fed to reconcile-discover over the last hour. Expected to spike then return to 0 as a finite backlog drains (each doc fed at most once). A value that never returns to 0 is the non-convergence signal.

panels.title: Sonnet avg completion tokens / call (near-cap detector) — BUG-071 P2
panels.description: sum(rate(completion[10m])) / sum(rate(success requests[10m])) for model=~claude-sonnet-4-6.*. Healthy: hundreds–low thousands. Warn (alert SonnetCompletionNearCap) > 6000; baseline-bad ~8097 ≈ the 8192 cap = every call maxing its output = truncation. NB: NOT stage-scoped (mixes RAG/resummarize Sonnet) — corroborating, biased downward (conservative).

panels.title: Sonnet token burn rate (completion + total)
panels.description: tg_parser_llm_tokens_total{model=~claude-sonnet-4-6.*}. Baseline-bad completion ≈ 236 tok/s sustained during the pre-fix incident. Watch completion-rate spikes that coincide with flat topics_created (the burn-without-progress signature, alert TopicizationBurnNoProgress).

panels.title: Topics created (rate) — recovery / progress signal
panels.description: sum(rate(tg_parser_topics_created_total[15m])) by (channel_id). After top-up this must go > 0 (cards being persisted = re-escalation cooldown disarms). The danger combo: truncation/token rate high while this stays 0 (alert TopicizationBurnNoProgress).

panels.title: Cumulative Sonnet tokens since dashboard window (cost guardrail)
panels.description: 1h increase of Sonnet tokens. Rollback cost guardrail (runbook §rollback trigger 5): > 2.4e6/hr (≈ the single-incident ~2.38M figure) while topics_created flat = stop spend. Tune to the agreed budget.

panels.title: Anthropic billing blocks (rate by stage) — must → 0 after top-up
panels.description: tg_parser_anthropic_billing_block_total{stage}. After a successful refill this rate must fall to 0. Sustained increments (alert AnthropicBillingStillBlocked) = top-up not effective / wrong key → processing won't drain.

panels.title: Processing throughput / backlog drain
panels.description: tg_parser_messages_processed_total{status} rate (should rise > 0 after top-up) + min channel coverage ratio (lowest-covered channel should trend up). The thing the refill is meant to resume.
